description: add of a name the target config already declares never replaces it (k101): the same backend and address – a local path spelled otherwise (`~`, a trailing `/`) naming the same directory, a git URL the same source identity (host case, trailing `/`, `.git`), either field of an entry with git and local – keeps the entry as written (`source N already added (<its fields>), kept as is`), trusts and syncs it, so a project-only source then installs; another address or another backend exits 1 naming the entry's backends and both ways out (with --project for the project config), nothing written. Only the target file counts: the user config takes a name the project declares.
